text.description_html:
Full Cover Polished Brass Door Closer

The Global TC611-US3 Polished Brass Door Closer are our most economically priced full cover closer. They are recommended for use on commercial, architectural and institutional applications. Ideal for business, new construction and renovations.

Global Series TC611-US3 Door Closers are non-handed and have individual adjustments for sweep speed, latch speed, and adjustable backcheck cushioning. They are tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm installations. They fit 11-3/32" x 3/4" mounting hole pattern and packaged complete with wood and machine screws.

The TC611-US3 is ADA Compliant offering adjustable spring power sizes 1 - 4 for use on interior doors requiring less than 5 lbs. of opening force and exterior doors requiring less than 8.5 lbs.

Features and Specifications: Global TC611-US3 ADA Compliant Polished Brass Door Closer

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 11-3/32"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Size: 44" interior / 36" exterior
  • Maximum Door Weight: 243 lbs
  • Spring Tension: Adjustable 1-4
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • Non Handed
  • ADA Compliant
  • UL 10C Approved
  • Includes Full Plastic Cover
  • Grade 1 Certified
  • 15 Year Manufacture Warranty
  • TC600 Series Instructions



This item is on Back Order: Use PDQ 5101-BCPA-605 Polished Brass Door Closer.
